name: Cinnarizine
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 30 mg 2 hours before travel, then 15 mg every 8 hours during the journey

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Alcohol, central nervous system depressants, tricyclic antidepressants

serious: Subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus, lichen planus

monitoring: Sedation; extrapyramidal signs in older adults

pk.excretion_renal_pct: Metabolites about one-third in urine, two-thirds in feces

sources.citation: JNTL Consumer Health I (Ireland) Limited. (2024). Stugeron 15 mg tablets (cinnarizine) [Summary of product characteristics, licence PA23490/024/001; text revised March 2024]. Health Products Regulatory Authority (Ireland).
